question: By what means should the supreme kuṇḍalinī power be engaged?
premises: The breath-mantra is specified as the means.
The object is the supreme kuṇḍalinī power.
The instruction is directed to the goddess.
inference: The supreme kuṇḍalinī power should be engaged by means of the breath-mantra.
plain_english: O goddess of gods, by the breath-mantra one should engage the supreme kuṇḍalinī power.
